body:
Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
We weren't able to process the credit or debit card we have on file for your account.
To avoid any interruption to your music service, please update your payment information at your earliest convenience.
Update your payment information
Log in to the Customer Portal:
https://portal.dynamicmediamusic.com
Username:
@Contact.Email@
First time logging in? Your temporary password is your Customer ID (@Customer.CustomerID@).
Once logged in:
Select Billing Details
Choose @BillingGroup.Name@
Update your payment method
Visit Invoices
Select Pay
Click Charge this Card ($@Order.Total@)
Need help?
Call our Customer Support team at 586-978-4214
Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET
Thank you,
Billing Team at Dynamic Media
